attribution: SPJ dataset, released by the NHBS-Net authors (Liu et al., IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging, 2021).

deidentification.basis: The authors identify the SPJ dataset and report that the study used fully anonymized reports and ultrasound images.
deidentification.visualReview: Codex visually inspected all three supplied frames: no visible names, dates, identifiers, or examination labels were observed.
deidentification.metadataReview: Only PNG IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks are present; no text or EXIF chunks.

scope: Public infant hip ultrasound examples from a DDH screening dataset. Individual diagnostic labels are not supplied. Training-set overlap is not assessed. This demo does not establish clinical accuracy or interval calibration.
selection: First three distinct standard-plane files in numeric filename order, selected before model inference. No selection based on prediction performance.
modifications: Files renamed for the demo; image bytes, pixels, orientation and metadata are unchanged.
